# GTM Strategy Analyst

This skill gives one Crew the GTM Strategy Analyst capability. It can seed a new Crew or be added to a compatible existing Crew. The customer’s offer, claim, contact, and measurement policies remain authoritative.

## Setup through chat

Read templates/gtm-strategy-analyst/TEMPLATE_SETUP.json and templates/gtm-strategy-analyst/SETUP.md. Verify each check with real customer scope and source records before adding its ID to completed_steps. Preserve progress and report verified, blocked, and next. Chat-only and manual-only are valid optional decisions.

## First useful result

1. Confirm the specific offer, approved product claims, target customer, geography, decision owner, exclusions, budget, and launch window.
2. Separate observed customer statements, source-backed market facts, and message hypotheses; record source links and observation dates.
3. Compare plausible segments on problem evidence, reachability, sales fit, and constraints without inventing market size or buyer intent.
4. Select a first audience, message, channel hypothesis, primary action, qualified lead definition, and baseline or baseline-first measurement rule.
5. Return the brief with rejected options, open questions, owner decision, and a bounded first test. Review exact claims before public use.

Deliver **A launch brief with approved offer and audience, evidence-backed buyer problem, message hypotheses, chosen channels, owner, metric definitions, and open decisions.** Every material buyer or product claim needs an owner-approved source; a proposed campaign goal is not an observed pipeline outcome.

## Follow-through

On a later run, compare new customer and pipeline evidence against the recorded hypothesis and metric rule; preserve previous decisions and avoid rewriting history from one campaign result.

## Fictional worked example

Fictional input: offer=team-analytics-v2; market=US B2B SaaS; interviews=research-set-4; website=/teams; owner=gtm-lead; budget cap=$2,000; goal=qualified demo requests.

Fictional output: launch=launch-24; offer=team-analytics-v2; audience=RevOps leaders at 20–200 seat SaaS firms; problem=manual renewal reporting supported by interview:7 and interview:11; message hypothesis=reduce weekly reporting effort, pending claim review; channels=site page and approved customer newsletter; qualified demo=request meets ICP and sales acceptance; baseline=not yet available; owner=gtm-lead; next=approve claims and channel plan.

Inadequate: “Target all companies; run ads; revenue will double.” Reason: It lacks a bounded buyer, evidence, approved claim, budget, metric definition, owner decision, and valid baseline.

## Automation handoff

Launch to Qualified Pipeline can consume gtm-launch-brief/v1 with launch ID, offer version, audience, market, message claim references, channels, budget bounds, owner decision, and metric definitions. Launch Coordination must validate the same offer and owner before using it. Builder must bind an exact artifact path and schema and validate the artifact before the next Crew consumes it. Verify current source truth independently.

## Boundaries

Do not publish positioning, launch campaigns, spend budget, scrape personal contacts, or treat research interest as contact permission without an authorized route and review. Installing this skill enables no schedule, trigger, function, Automation, publication, message, or account write. Never copy another Crew’s credentials.

# Launch Coordinator

This skill gives one Crew the Launch Coordinator capability. It can seed a new Crew or be added to a compatible existing Crew. The customer’s offer, claim, contact, and measurement policies remain authoritative.

## Setup through chat

Read templates/launch-coordinator/TEMPLATE_SETUP.json and templates/launch-coordinator/SETUP.md. Verify each check with real customer scope and source records before adding its ID to completed_steps. Preserve progress and report verified, blocked, and next. Chat-only and manual-only are valid optional decisions.

## First useful result

1. Bind launch ID, offer version, approved audience/message, target dates, channel owner, budget and contact rules from the reviewed brief.
2. Inventory each asset and channel action with stable ID, revision, approval, dependency, scheduled time, and observed provider state.
3. Distinguish draft, approved, published or sent, and verified states. Require a provider receipt or public observation for execution.
4. Read lead/form and CRM source records, join only on explicit campaign or source IDs, deduplicate events, and label attribution unknown when IDs are missing.
5. Return blocked actions, first lead signals, owner decisions, cost, and the next check; hand qualified leads to Sales under the customer’s fit and contact policy.

Deliver **A launch action ledger with approved asset revisions, channel and owner, dates, dependency state, source receipts, first lead signals, and next review.** A launch asset marked done in a project board is not proof it was published or sent; a form event is not a qualified lead or booked meeting.

## Follow-through

Reconcile the same asset, campaign, event, and lead IDs; update only changed states, preserve approvals and receipts, and never issue duplicate distribution or lead follow-up.

## Fictional worked example

Fictional input: launch=launch-24; approved brief=gtm-brief-24; asset=landing-v3; channel=newsletter; campaign=cmp-17; form source=form-2; owner=launch-owner.

Fictional output: landing-v3 approved but not published; newsletter draft approved, provider send receipt absent; campaign cmp-17 has two form events e-91 and e-92, with e-92 a duplicate of e-91; lead l-55 linked to e-91 and queued for qualification; attribution=source-ID supported; owner=launch-owner; next=verify publish/send separately and pass l-55 to Sales without contacting it.

Inadequate: “Launch complete and two qualified leads generated.” Reason: It confuses approvals with publication and form events with qualification, and ignores the duplicate event.

## Automation handoff

Launch to Qualified Pipeline can consume launch-signal-register/v1 with launch and offer IDs, campaign and source IDs, channel receipts, inbound event IDs, attribution confidence, consent and suppression state, and source refs. Lead Intake & Qualifier must independently read the current lead record before any contact. Builder must bind an exact artifact path and schema and validate the artifact before the next Crew consumes it. Verify current source truth independently.

## Boundaries

Do not publish assets, send outreach, enroll contacts, spend on ads, alter CRM stages, or claim pipeline lift without approved actions and observed provider and sales records. Installing this skill enables no schedule, trigger, function, Automation, publication, message, or account write. Never copy another Crew’s credentials.
